title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 10 — Award Start and End Dates
content:
**10.1** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), an approved award runs from the award start date to the award end date.

**10.2 Start.** The award start date is the application date minus the retroactive service look-back days, in calendar days, so open balances of services in that look-back are covered.

**10.3 End.** The award end date is the determination date plus the tier's award eligibility months in calendar months, falling back to the last day of the month when that month has no such day.

**10.4 Expiry.** The award expires the day after the award end date.

**10.5 Approval conditions.** A patient may be approved only when the case is complete, any required BadgerCare Plus screening is resolved, and the tier is determined.

### Worked dates (hypothetical; look-back taken as 365 days, eligibility as 6 months)

| Input | Result |
|---|---|
| Application date 2030-06-30 | award start date 2029-06-30 (365 calendar days earlier) |
| Determination date 2030-08-15 | award end date 2031-02-15 |
| Determination date 2030-08-31 | award end date 2031-02-28 (February has no 31st, so the last day of that month) |
| Award end date 2031-02-28 | the award expires on 2031-03-01 |
